evidence.name: Screen Editor: Header
evidence.userNeed: Know what the Header section controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Header section
sections.description: Controls the bar at the top of the screen: the Back and Skip buttons and the progress indicator that shows how far through the flow a visitor is. Most screens inherit sensible defaults — style the progress indicator (kind and colors) so it matches your brand.

sections.title: Where it appears
sections.description: Covered screen types: HeroContent, Carousel, ListMultiPick, ListSinglePick, GridMultiPick, GridSinglePick, ProgressSteps, TextInput, WheelPicker, HeroList, WebEmbed.
